review: Request: at round 61 Ivo (health 100, satiety 80.3, energy 33.244 of 40, body temperature 24.24, standing on meadow ground at (15.8, 18) at night with no animal in view, owning only the root stack item-7-ivo-76) asked to sleep safely where he is, with an actual trial of whether sleep restores energy, reporting 32 rounds of rest with zero recovered energy and not knowing why. World Agent decision: develop (learning 1) a general sleep at the current location with start, continue, wake/cancel and status and a whole-round duration (default 1); recovery only through the existing rest recovery (forest.rest of foundation-forest@1), at most once per completed eligible interval, with its real modifiers and cap and no second energy source; suitability from reachable, unoccupied supporting ground and represented exposure rules, with no bedding or shelter supplied and unmet conditions reported; per-interval records of pre-energy, eligibility, actual credit, other debits and post-energy; wake or pause on threat, exposure, lost support or injury; interruption, cancellation and death rules; and an inspection of the rest path that fixes a demonstrated defect there rather than adding a bypass. Rest finding: the shared rest path has no defect. base.rest (continuous-base.ts, wrapped unchanged as forest.rest) sets energy to min(40, energy + (4 + registered facility bonus) x mood rest factor x lean-shelter factor); Ivo's retained per-round records for rounds 22-53 show action rest at energy 40 with recovery 0, so he rested at the cap and zero was the correct recovery, not a fault. The test confirms that rest at 40 adds 0, at 30 adds exactly 4, from 37.5 stops at 40 and at mood 0.5 adds 4.2 (factor 1.05), and that a slept interval gives identical vitals and rest data in each of these states and at Ivo's 33.244; no shared rest or runtime behavior was changed to obtain this. Implemented: sleep-in-place@1 (ability sleep-in-place, handler long.sleep-in-place, equivalence body:sleep:rest-recovery-interval:1, events sleep-entered, sleep-interval-completed, sleep-recovery-measured, sleep-interrupted, sleep-woken, sleep-status and sleep-ended; learning 1 without study energy; dependency foundation-open@1 and an execution dependency on the rest ability; 2,700 code units; appended last to the package list) from a new sleepPackage(id, scope) factory. start (duration 1-40, default 1) checks before any change that the person is alive; that the ground under the body is firm by the ex19 rule (not water, shallow water, a wet bank or waterlogging above 0.1); that no other living body touches it and no object footprint lies within the 0.22 body radius, an enclosing interior excepted; that no active drought or waterlogging hazard area covers the point; that no burning hearth or fire bed reaches the body; that body temperature (vitals.temperature, not air) is inside the world's thermal comfort band 16-27 now and after one round of the forestPhysiology update (shelterTemperature: 0.035 of the gap, divided by 1 + insulation) toward the forest climate air temperature, which already includes outdoor rain and wind exposure and interior buffering; and that no living wolf or boar is in the person's current view. A failed check refuses at no cost and names every unmet condition with the property bedding or shelter would need. Entry creates a work record (workCreate) with the support reference, posture lying, phase asleep and the entry tick and emits sleep-entered, and the same round is the first interval: the handler calls FOREST_BASE.handlers['forest.rest'] itself, as the resting-patch and moss rest trials do, so the round recovers exactly what rest would in that state, once (a second recovery in one round throws, tested). Each interval record keeps energy before, eligibility, the rest credit with its nominal value, mood factor and cap, whether the credit stopped at the cap, whether a zero was the cap or an unresolved accounting fault, and, settled from the world's per-round vital record in the following round (or from the body at death), energy after, other debits, net change and the satiety, health and body temperature changes, announced by sleep-recovery-measured. Repeating start through a plan or operation continuation, or continue, sleeps the next interval after fresh checks, and reaching the requested count wakes the person (sleep-woken); a failed recheck at an interval is a blocked round without recovery that pauses the sleep; after each round's environment, a round not slept (another action, study, status, a rejected action or none) pauses it, and an injury, a wolf or boar coming into view, lost support, a hazard area, fire or exposure wakes the person (sleep-interrupted with the reasons; completed intervals stay); continue lies down again after fresh checks with a new entry, start does not reopen an interrupted sleep, walking away ends it, and wake or cancel ends it at no cost without undoing time, hunger or recovery; status (one round, no energy) reports the phase, every interval record and the current checks; death ends an open sleep with sleep-ended, no later recovery and the ordinary death and possession rules. View metadata (component null, operation, work, actor, support, position, posture, phase, slept and requested intervals, last credit and last net change, interruption, entry ticks, badge null) is on every event and in the person's state, and lying and asleep appear only after a real entry; visualComponents is empty because no existing drawing shows a lying body and no rest variant, facility or shelter package sets a sleeping posture. Experience: no reward, satisfaction or practice milestone is added: the practice evidence is sleep-woken, which never carries a qualified flag; one verified personal record per result kind (credited, none at the cap) keeps the first measured interval of each sleep, and its information-confirmed event follows the existing verified-information rule only once per kind; one gated line in open-experience.ts adds sleep-in-place to the subsistence actions of the routine rule only where sleep-in-place@1 is installed, so a slept round counts as the same routine as a rest round and is neither progress work nor relief from routine (tested against resting); without that revision nothing changes and every earlier run replays identically. Modeling assumptions: (1) an interval is one round, and lying down shares the entry round with the first interval, so there is no separate entering round; (2) the longest sleep is 40 rounds, half the 80-round day; (3) exposure uses the existing thermal comfort band of the physical wellbeing term, which a sleeper should stay inside, rather than the 7 and 34 thermal damage limits (harm, not suitability) or the 16-22 band of recuperation (a healing criterion), and the one-round projection omits package-specific shelter, mantle and fire adjustments, none of which is installed here, while the actual body temperature is rechecked every round; (4) sleep changes no represented physiology or perception: hunger continues at 0.9 a round, body temperature follows the same law and the sleeper's view is the waking view, so unseen threats are not detected and nearby people give no protection; (5) threats are living wolves and boars, the only animals with represented attacks on people and the species the respawn safety rule avoids, while deer are harmless; (6) firm ground follows the ex19 rule, so rocky ground supports a sleeper, ground comfort is not represented and loose ground stacks do not occupy ground; (7) a burning area is an object with positive burning fuel whose footprint reaches the body, where the represented contact burn acts; (8) any active development hazard area at the point blocks sleep; (9) a round's recovery is applied at the action, as rest's is, so an injury or exposure later in the same round wakes the person before the next interval without revoking the credit already applied, and no partial interval exists; (10) status or any other action uses the action channel and therefore wakes the sleeper; (11) post-round values come from the world's own per-round vital record, so other debits and the net change appear one round later; (12) walking away from an interrupted sleep ends it. Reuse: forest.rest unchanged (base.rest, the facility bonus, forestRestFactor, the lean factor and refuge accounting), shelterTemperature, forestClimate, openConditions, ex19MaterialGround, the ex20 ground names, v7Observe, workCreate and collectiveJobs, openRemember and the per-round experience record; every other package is byte-identical (sha256 asserted for the two other packages of this run and foundation-forest, and all 113 earlier package hashes compared unchanged); one test of the first development of this run that listed its scope's packages exactly was narrowed to its own first two. A throwaway check on the archived round-61 world installed the package, reported every check met by status before entry, had Ivo learn it in one round and sleep four intervals through a plan on the meadow ground where he stands (air 24.6, rain 0.36, wind 0.08, body 24.25): +4.0042 (mood factor 1.00105, 33.244 to 37.248), +2.7515 to the cap, then 0 and 0 recorded as no credit at the cap, each net change equal to its credit and satiety falling 0.9 a round; it was deleted afterwards. What Ivo can do now: learn sleep in one round and sleep where he is, recovering what rest recovers (about 4 a round) up to the cap of 40, with records that show a zero at 40 as the cap; neither rest nor sleep raises energy above 40. First release: no; the specification is self-consistent and is implemented as a simplified but real mechanism with real rounds, the real rest recovery, state changes and events, and its demonstrated-defect clause found no defect to fix.
